summary: Start and stop approved auxiliary services from DjangoLux while keeping the control path available.
highlights: Typed service-start/service-stop operations for existing allow-listed containers, paired with DjangoLux 1.14.0b3.
Agent and executor independently enforce protected services, labels, allowlists and current state; Web/Celery, proxies, data and Composer services remain protected.
Service capabilities reflect actual state. Existing restart/recreate, logs, updates and maintenance-page support are retained.
